text:
mira: Kickoff thread for benchmark assets  need a tight narrative + 3 visuals: heatmap (workloads vs knobs), waterfall (savings breakdown), and a tail-latency CDF. audience: devs + infra buyers.
devon: Heatmap rows: workload shapes (burst/steady/convo), cols: knobs (batch, kv-cache, quant). cells = % savings vs baseline. easy to scan.
priya: Waterfall to show cumulative savings: quantization -> batching -> cache -> routing. annotate realistic deltas (not headline-max).
cale: Tail CDF is key for SREs  show p50/p95/p99 shifts with cache enabled. include uncertainty band.
benchbot: data export: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/1761239999 file bench-heatmap-v1.csv (burst/steady/convo, q8/q4/no-quant, batch sizes 1/8/32, cache on/off).
mira: Landing page CTAs: Try API (devs), Request ROI review (platform buyers), Download gated calc (email). Split-test CTA copy on page: "See your token savings" vs "Estimate your monthly inference bill".
devon: Calculator idea: slider for monthly requests + workload type -> shows $/mo saved and estimated p95. Also show "what affects this most" bar rank. Provide CSV import.
priya: Messaging: headline: "Benchmark your latency-to-dollar tradeoffs" subhead: "Find the configuration that fits your SLOs and budget." Social hook: "Which workloads save the most? Quick calculator + benchmark pack."
cale: Inbound routing: form field "monthly_tokens" and "workload" -> score leads by projected monthly savings. >$1k/month savings -> SDR. Tag "bench_interest".
mira: Webinar plan (20m): problem statement (3m), live demo + calc (10m), customer mini-case (3m), quick Q&A + CTA (4m). Offer gated spreadsheet template.
devon: Visual asks: heatmap PNG 1200x630, waterfall SVG for blog, CDF plot PNG + small thumbnail. make all accessible colors.
priya: Copy microcopy near calc: "Estimates assume steady traffic & typical tokenization; results will vary with prompt mix."
benchbot: export note: kneepoint numbers (batch=8, cache on) -> median unit saving 32% for steady workloads; will attach CSV.
mira: Timeline: numbers + rough mock Tue, visuals Wed, gated calc live Fri, blog + social next Mon, webinar in two weeks. Owners: devon numbers & calc, priya copy, cale visuals, mira launch.
devon: I'll drop the CSV and kneepoint annotations Tue AM.
cale: I'll post figma links Wed EOD.
priya: I'll craft 3 social variants for A/B test.
mira: Great. small follow-ups: everyone include realistic deltas (no overclaim), and provide alt text for each visual. We'll review Wed afternoon. :sparkles:
